text:
rachel (partnerships): Datadog asked if we can include an observability quickstart + marketplace dashboard for a joint launch. They specifically want GPU metrics, trace sampling guidance, and privacy blurb.

ben (eng-runtime): We emit `redwood.gpu.util_pct`, `redwood.gpu.mem_mb`, `redwood.gpu.temp_c` with tags: node, gpu_index, instance_type, model.name. Can map to Datadog names.

viv (eng-sre): For traces I recommend tail-sampling: 0.5% baseline, 100% for error spans and spans >400ms. Will add example sampler config for OTEL collector.

li (devex): I'll build the marketplace JSON with widgets: GPU heatmap, model latency p50/p95, trace flamegraph, tokens/sec, cache hit rate. Also include a dashboard variable for $/kWh.

amy (dd-pdm): Good. Please prefix metrics with `redwood.` for consistency. Add `env` and `region` tags. We also need two screenshots and a one-paragraph telemetry blurb (no PII, opt-out steps).

compliance-bot: Reminder: telemetry blurb must reference our policy and include contact for opt-out: privacy@redwood.internal.

ben (eng-runtime): We'll strip prompt text from traces and only keep model.id, route, and anonymized request_id. Documented in quickstart.

viv (eng-sre): Ops monitors to suggest: GPU util p95 >90% (warning), temp >80C (critical), memory >95% (warning). I'll add JSON snippets for alerts.

li (devex): Timeline: can we have draft dashboard + quickstart + blurb by Fri (1800270000)? Amy, does that fit your QA window?

amy (dd-pdm): Yes, if we get drafts by Fri we can QA and schedule marketplace publish the following week. Also happy to do a quick handoff call.

rachel (partnerships): Thanks all. I'll collect assets and schedule the DD QA slot once uploaded. Ping this thread when ready. :thumbsup:
